scripts.build: pnpm run assets && pnpm run test:isolation && next build && node scripts/check-build.ts
scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm --filter @opensignet/shared build && pnpm --filter @opensignet/sdk build && pnpm run assets && pnpm run test:isolation && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local && node scripts/check-build.ts && node scripts/check-open-next.ts
scripts.preview: pnpm run build:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env preview
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:cloudflare:production && node ../../scripts/seo/indexnow.ts verify --site=frontend --production && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env="" && node ../../scripts/seo/indexnow.ts submit --site=frontend --production
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run assets && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.typecheck:ci: pnpm run assets && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.test: pnpm run assets && node --test "test/*.test.ts" && tsx --test "test/source/*.test.ts" && pnpm run test:seo
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run assets && node --test "test/*.test.ts" && tsx --test "test/source/*.test.ts" && pnpm run test:seo
